# Syed Ali Abdul Baqi — Motion Designer & Website Designer-Developer (London, UK)

> I create animations, motion-driven experiences, and custom-designed websites that I develop using modern technologies and platforms.

## Professional Positioning & Specializations

Syed Ali Abdul Baqi is a London-based Visual Artist, Motion Designer, and Custom Website Designer & Developer with 8+ years of multidisciplinary experience. He designs and develops custom websites end to end around business goals and technical requirements — connecting visual website design directly with full-stack website development across modern platforms.

### Priority Hierarchy
1. **Animation & Motion Design** (Primary Specialization): Showreels, hero campaign films, kinetic typography, stop-motion, social motion spots, and motion-driven digital storytelling.
2. **Custom Website Design & Development** (Secondary Specialization): Connected visual design and bespoke full-stack website development — custom business websites, creative landing pages, responsive layouts, website redesigns, and custom-coded builds engineered with **React.js**, **Next.js**, and **Laravel**.
3. **CMS & E-Commerce Website Platforms**: Dedicated platform development across **WordPress** (custom PHP themes, ACF/block CMS, WooCommerce) and **Shopify** (Online Store 2.0, Liquid, D2C storefronts).
